summary: Verified iteration 23 frontend fixes for CheerPlanner — (A) TimeField stacking on Schedule/DateTimeField/CompetitionTeamsSection so AM/PM toggle never clips, and (B) discoverable 'Email reminders' row at top of Settings with live frequency badge. All targeted flows PASS on 390x844, 360x800, and 320x568 viewports.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' is fired 3x on the Settings screen (and again on Notifications). Likely a stray whitespace text node inside a <View>. Not blocking, but should be hunted down — possibly inside the SettingRow `value && <Text>` JSX where the trailing curly braces leave a stray space. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx around the SettingRow render / Help section.

action_items: (Optional) Track down the 'Unexpected text node' RN warning emitted on the Settings & Notifications screens — likely a stray space/empty expression between JSX siblings inside a <View>. Non-blocking but noisy.

(Optional) The Notifications preferences screen labels options as 'Daily digest' / 'Weekly digest' / 'Off' while the Settings badge shows 'Daily' / 'Weekly' / 'Off'. Consider aligning copy (e.g. badge could say 'Daily digest') for absolute clarity — purely cosmetic.

(Minor regression spotted, unrelated to this iteration) /app/frontend/app/schedule/new.tsx line 261–262 renders TWO consecutive labels: 'Location (optional)' followed by 'Location / venue name'. Looks like an accidental duplicate. Reference: /app/frontend/app/schedule/new.tsx:261-263 — please remove the redundant label.
critical_code_review_comments: schedule/new.tsx lines 261-263 have a duplicate label rendered above the location TextInput ('Location (optional)' then 'Location / venue name'). Remove one — likely leftover from a previous edit.

TimeField.tsx web styles use flexWrap:'wrap' + columnGap to allow ONLY the clear icon to drop to a 2nd row on tight containers — implementation matches the comment, verified empirically at 320px viewport.

DateTimeField & CompetitionTeamsSection stacking is implemented with separate label rows + per-field full-width components — verified via bounding boxes (perf.y > meet.y + label height, same x column).
Settings notifications row uses useFocusEffect + a /notifications/preferences GET to keep the badge live; verified the badge updates Daily → Weekly → Off → Daily on each round-trip.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via [data-testid="login-email-input"] / [data-testid="login-password-input"] / [data-testid="login-submit-button"]. Schedule new form TimeFields expose hour/minute/period sub-testIDs (e.g. schedule-start-time-hour, -minute, -period). Notifications screen uses RADIO options labeled 'Daily digest' / 'Weekly digest' / 'Off' (NOT plain 'Daily'/'Weekly') — match via `text=/Weekly digest/`. Settings row testID is `settings-notifications`. Console emits a benign 'Unexpected text node' warning on Settings — non-blocking but worth tracking.
rca_of_issue: Per the review request, root causes were already identified and fixed. Verification confirms: (A) Stacking TimeFields vertically gives each picker the full container width (358px on a 390px viewport), so the AM/PM period button now lands at x≈108–142, well within all three tested viewports (320/360/390). At 320px width the period button stays on the same row as the HH:MM inputs (period.y diff vs hour.y = 3px). (B) New 'Reminders & notifications' section header + 'Email reminders' label + live frequency badge make the entry point obvious; the duplicate 'Notifications' row in Help & support has been removed (substring count = 0 in body).
